description: Product updates, news, plans, and social pointers.

items.title: CuNi 0.1.9 — 119 languages, same stdout or refuse
items.body: cuni check emit+runs the 119-language catalog. Native seats: Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, C, C++, Rust. Other ids emit+run via Python lowering. Studio is free. Closed-app exception $490/year.

items.title: Press: dual-licensed hosted compression + npm clients
items.body: PCC is live under a dual license. slid-phi 2.3.0, spl-pay-per-suite 1.2.0, blackjack-compression 1.6.0, and @cptasz13/tru8 0.2.0 call the live host. First 2 GB/month free, then 8¢/GB.

items.title: CuNi 0.1.8 — write once, print many languages
items.body: CuNi now emits a catalog of coding languages from one source. Python, Go, and JavaScript still have to print the same thing, or the compiler refuses. Studio is free. Closed-app exception $490/year.
